summary.text: Mark Hackett is the Constitution Party candidate for U.S. Senate in South Carolina. He was the party's nominee for U.S. House in 2020 and 2024, and 2026 is his first run for Senate. Little biographical information about him is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Hackett ran as the Constitution Party candidate in South Carolina's 6th Congressional District in 2020, receiving 0.9% (2,646 votes) in the general election won by James Clyburn.
In 2024 he won the Constitution Party convention vote for South Carolina's 4th District, 8 to 5 over Michael Chandler, and received 2.8% (9,779 votes) in the general election won by William Timmons.
He is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for U.S. Senate as the Constitution Party candidate.
